newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy offers 14 trln lire of BOTs for sale.
newsitem.headline: Italy offers 14 trln lire of BOTs for sale.

text.p: The Italian treasury said it was offering 14.0 trillion lire of short term bills (BOT), replacing 17.5 trillion lire of expiring paper.
A Treasury statement said it would offer:
Subscriptions close at 1200 GMT on January 10.
The Treasury also announced the debut of new 18-month zero couponed certificates (CTZ), saying it would offer 2.0 trillion lire of the new paper at auction on January 10.
At the same time, it said it would offer 2.5 trillion lire of traditional two year CTZ.
Subscriptions for these sales both close at 1200 GMT on January 10. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
